lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 6 visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with higher spatial frequency observed on the anterior flank and increasing inter-centroid distance posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs at regular intervals, forming a geometric grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features along the superior flank displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient, consisting of high-intensity upper boundaries and shadowed inferior margins running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated, high-luminance biological entity attached to the distal posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
